out_items.name: Certified Food Protection Manager

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. OBSERVED NO CERTIFIED FOOD MANAGER ONSITE AT BEGINNING OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. CFM ARRIVED DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE MORE STAFF RECEIVE A CERTIFIED FOOD MANAGER CERTIFICATION AND A CFM IS ONSITE DURING ALL HOURS OF OPERATION TO PREVENT FURTHER ENFORCEMENT ACTION.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: OBSERVED FOOD DEBRIS IN BOTH HANDWASHING SINKS IN THE BACK KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. EHS PROVIDED GUIDANCE. PLEASE ENSURE ALL STAFF UNDERSTAND HANDWASHING SINKS SHOULD BE USED FOR HANDWASHING ONLY.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Storage-Personal Care Items
violations.observation: OBSERVED A NASAL IRRIGATION BOTEL STORED NEAR CLEAN PLATES IN THE DISHWASHING AREA.
violations.corrective_action: All employees' personal care items shall be stored in a way that prevents the contamination of food and food contact surfaces through improper labeling or storage. EHS PROVIDED GUIDANCE AND THE PIC MOVED THE PERSONAL CARE ITEM.

out_items.name: Thermometers provided and accurate

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold or hot holding equipment: THREE-DOOR PREP-TOP.
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. PLEASE ADD A UNIT THERMOMETER TO THIS UNIT AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: OBSERVED COOLING COOKED CHICKEN STORED ON THE FLOOR UNDER A SHELF NEAR THE COOK-LINE.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. EHS PROVIDED GUIDANCE AND PIC MOVED CHICKEN TO WALK-IN. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED CORRECTION. KALPASI INDIAN CUISINE (Inspection Date: 07/27/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Equip/Utensils/Linens Stored off Floor, Clean Location
violations.observation: Observed that clean POTS were stored ON THE FLOOR UNDER SHELVES NEAR DISHWASHING AREA that exposed the items to contamination.
violations.corrective_action: Store clean equipment, utensils, and linens in a clean, dry location where they are not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination and at least 6 inches above the floor. PLEASE ENSURE ALL CLEAN EQUIPMENT IS ELEVATED OFF THE GROUND TO PREVENT CONTAMINATION.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Corrosion-Resistant/Nonabsorbent Materials
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment and/or utensils are not durable: OBSERVED SOME FOOD ITEMS IN THE FREEZER IN DIRECT CONTACT WITH GROCERY BAGS.
violations.corrective_action: Materials that are used in the construction of utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to food and under normal use conditions shall be durable, corrosion-resistant, and nonabsorbent. PLEASE DO NOT USE GROCERY BAGS TO STORE FOOD ITEMS DIRECTLY AS THEY ARE NOT FOOD GRADE/FOOD SAFE.

out_items.name: Non-food contact surfaces clean

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: OBSERVED THE INTERIOR OF THE THREE-DOOR PREP TOP AND ALL COOK-LINE EQUIPMENT IN NEED OF CLEANING.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. PLEASE THOROUGHLY CLEAN THE INTERIOR OF THIS EQUIPMENT AS SOON AS POSSIBLE. .

out_items.name: Plumbing installed, proper backflow devices

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: OBSERVED THE WOMEN’S RESTROOM TOILET LEAK WHEN FLUSHED.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. PLEASE ENSURE THE TOILET IS REPAIRED AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: OBSERVED HOLES IN THE CEILING THROUGHOUT THE BACK KITCHEN AND IN THE WALL ABOVE THE WALK-IN COOLER.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. PLEASE SEAL THESE HOLES THROUGHOUT THE BACK KITCHEN WITH FOAMING CAULK OR NEW TILES AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: OBSERVED THE WALLS AND FLOORS THROUGHOUT THE BACK KITCHEN IN NEED OF CLEANING.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. PLEASE THOROUGHLY CLEAN THE BACK KITCHEN AS SOON AS POSSIBLE AND INCREASE CLEANING FREQUENCY OF THE BACK KITCHEN TO PREVENT GRIME ACCUMULATION.

out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.corrective_action: EHS SPOKE WITH OWNER REGARDING UNFINISHED AMENDMENT. PLEASE ENSURE REQUIRED DOCUMENTATION NECESSARY FOR THE AMENDMENT ARE SUBMITTED AS SOON AS POSSIBLE AND PRIOR TO THE FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION. out_items.name: Hands clean and properly washed

violations.title: Where to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee was observed cleaning their hands in a food preparation sink, warewashing sink or in a mop sink. OBSERVED EMPLOYEE WASH HANDS AT BAR THREE-VAT SINK.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands in ONLY a designated handsink. EHS PROVIDED GUIDANCE. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED CORRECTION. KALPASI INDIAN CUISINE (Inspection Date: 01/30/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food items were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED MILK AT 50F, SHREDDED CABBAGE AT 52F, PANEER AT 52F, UNSALTED BUTTER AT 50F, PANEER #2 AT 51F, YOGURT AT 50F, SHREDDED CHEESE AT 50F, VEGETABLE BIRYANI AT 50F, AND RAITA AT 49F IN THE WALK-IN COOLER. OBSERVED COOKED GOAT AT 44F AND SAMOSAS AT 48F IN THE THREE- DOOR PREP TOP.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC DISCARDED OF FOODS DURING INSPECTION AND UNDERSTANDS COLD HOLDING FOODS SHOULD ALWAYS BE KEPT AT 41F OR BELOW. PLEASE ENSURE THE WALK-IN COOLER IS NOT USED FOR ANY TCS FOODS UNTIL IT HAS BEEN REPAIRED.

out_items.name: Proper date marking and disposition

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: OBSERVED INCONSISTENT DATE MARKING SYSTEM IN PLACE AT TIME OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. PLEASES ENSURE A CONSISTENT DATE MARKING SYSTEM IS IN PLACE BY THE TIME OF THE FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Pest Control Methods
violations.observation: Methods are not being used to control pests. OBSERVED ONE LIVE COCKROACH ON BULK-CONTAINER.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. If pests are found on the premises methods shall be used to control their presence. PIC WILL ENSURE PEST CONTROL SERVICES THE ESTABLISHMENT PRIOR TO FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food on Display, Guards/Packaging
violations.observation: OBSERVED BUFFET EQUIPMENT ON COUNTER-TOP IN THE BACK OF DINING AREA WITHOUT SNEEZE GUARDS.
violations.corrective_action: Food on display shall be protected from contamination by the use of packaging, counter, service line, or salad bar food guards, display cases, or other effective means. PIC PLACED ORDER FOR SNEEZE GUARDS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE THEY ARE INSTALLED AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: OBSERVED THE WALK-IN COOLER AT 50F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. TECHNICIAN HAD TRIED TO FIX THE WALK-IN THE MORNING OF THE INSPECTION AND WILL RETURN LATER WITH NECESSARY PARTS. PLEASE ENSURE PROOF OF REPAIR IS PROVIDED TO EHS AS SOON AS POSSIBLE AND THAT TCS FOODS ARE NOT STORED IN THE COOLER UNTIL IT CAN MAINTAIN 34-38F.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Durable/Smooth Materials
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surface of the following equipment is not corrosion resistant, nonabsorbent, and/or smooth: OBSERVED TINFOIL LINING SHELVES THROUGHOUT BACK KITCHEN AND COOK-LINE EQUIPMENT.
violations.corrective_action: Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other foods that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a corrosion- resistant, nonabsorbent, and smooth material. PLEASE DISCONTINUE USE OF TINFOIL; FACILITY MAY USE PLEXIGLASS-GLASS, STAINLESS STEEL, OR ANOTHER DURABLE AND EASY TO CLEAN MATERIAL.

out_items.name: Toilet facilities properly constructed, supplied, and cleaned

violations.title: Toilet Room Convenient/Accessible
violations.observation: OBSERVED BOTH RESTROOMS NON-OPERATIONAL AT TIME OF INSPECTION DUE TO CONSTRUCTION TO DINING AREA.
violations.corrective_action: Ensure that the toilet room(s) is conveniently accessible to employees during all hours of operation to encourage employee use of appropriate facilities. PIC DISCONTINUED OUTDOOR SEATING TO CUSTOMERS DURING INSPECTION AND UNDERSTANDS TAKE-OUT ORDERS ARE ONLY PERMITTED WHILE RESTROOMS ARE NOT OPERATIONAL. PLEASE LET THE EHS KNOW WHEN THE TOILETS ARE OPERATING AGAIN.

out_items.name: Food-contact surfaces cleaned and sanitized

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: OBSERVED DISHWASHING MACHINE NOT DELIVERING SANITIZER DURING INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. PIC SET UP THREE-VAT SINK AND UNDERSTANDS DISHWASHING MACHINE SHOULD NOT BE USED UNTIL IT HAS BEEN REPAIRED. EHS WILL CONFIRM DISHWASHING MACHINE IS REPAIRED AT TIME OF FOLLOW-UP.

out_items.name: Proper cooling time and temperature

violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 41F, No More than 6 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety food are not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours: OBSERVED SAMBAR IN FREEZER, MADE THE NIGHT PRIOR TO INSPECTION, AT 39-60F. PIC CONFIRMED WITH EHS THAT FOOD WAS LEFT OUTSIDE ON COUNTER-TOP TO COOL OVERNIGHT.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded. PIC DISCARDED THE SAMBAR DURING INSPECTION AND UNDERSTANDS THAT COOLING FOODS SHOULD NEVER BE LEFT OUT OVERNIGHT, AND MUST MEET 41F OR BELOW WITHIN A TOTAL OF 6 HOURS.

violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 70F, No More than 2 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety foods are not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours: OBSERVED COOKED CHICKEN BIRYANI ON COUNTER-TOP AT 102-116F, FOR MORE THAN 2 HOURS.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded. PIC DISCARDED BIRYANI DURING INSPECTION AND UNDERSTANDS FOODS MUST COOL FROM 135F TO 70F WITHIN 2 HOURS.

out_items.name: Proper hot holding temperatures

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item was observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED COOKED RICE ON STOVE-TOP AT 119-125F FOR APPROXIMATELY 3+ HOURS.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. PIC DISCARDED RICE DURING INSPECTION AND UNDERSTANDS HOT FOODS MUST BE KEPT AT 135F OR ABOVE AT ALL TIMES.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: PEELED GARLIC manufacturer containers were observed reused for the storage of VARIOUS SPICES.
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. PLEASE DISCONTINUE REUSE OF GARLIC CONTAINERS AS THEY ARE NOT NSF-APPROVED AND NOT DURABLE.
